findings.evidence: AudioRecord captures voice and emits it to audioFrames, which MainViewModel collects and sends via maveSessionManager.sendAudio().
findings.recommendation: Audio collection is user-initiated and exempt from prominent disclosure, but must be declared in the Play Store Data Safety form.

findings.evidence: CrashlyticsTree is planted in MyApplication.onCreate() before the user can accept the privacy policy in WelcomeScreen, acting as a false gatekeeper.
findings.recommendation: Delay the initialization of Crashlytics and Timber.plant(CrashlyticsTree()) until after the user has explicitly accepted the privacy policy in the WelcomeScreen.

findings.evidence: localStorage is used locally in DevicesScreen to store mave_hud_mode. It is not transferred off-device.
findings.recommendation: No action required. Local-only data does not need to be declared in the Data Safety form.
